statement.p: Let A = \left[\begin{array}{cc} 6 \amp 5\cr -5 \amp -2\cr 31 \amp 15 \end{array}\right] \ \mbox{ and } \ \vec{b} = \left[\begin{array}{c} 7\cr 5\cr -18 \end{array}\right]. Define the linear transformation T: {\mathbb R}^2 \rightarrow {\mathbb R}^3 by T(\vec{x}) = A\vec{x}. Find a vector \vec{x} whose image under T is \vec{b}.

Is the vector \vec{x} unique?
choose
unique
not unique
